name: agent-engine
description: Skills that help choose a game engine or web stack for agent-built projects (ease of AI-assisted development against quality and reach, with limits) and glue agent-sprites, agent-meshes and agent-beeps assets into Unity, Godot and the web: how each engine imports them, what has been verified, and a sample scene that acts as the acceptance test. Also web 3D skills for React Three Fiber and Babylon.js, custom-renderer shaders and genre visual polish. Unreal and UEFN are in the agent-unreal plugin; Phaser is in the agent-phaser plugin. Early: Godot, Unity and the web tier (three.js, React Three Fiber, Babylon.js) are tested.
